# CoD2 1.3 walker anims, retail cod2_lnxded on mp_toujane (stock dm, sv_pure 1)
# in a loopback-only namespace (unshare -rn), dm.gsc from iw_15.iwd loaded
# from the homepath with one addition: 6 s after each spawn the client named
# walker runs `self suicide()`. Two vcod-cod2 `examples/spectate` clients,
# both `--anims`: `--join --name watcher` first, then 3 s later
# `--join --fly --name walker` (forward held, turning ~90 deg/s; taps use
# while dead, which stock dm respawns on).
# `w` lines: the walker's own snapshots, `a <serverTime> ps <legsAnim>
# <torsoAnim> <legsTimer> <torsoTimer>`. `s` lines: the watcher's snapshots
# that carried a body: `| e <num> t<eType> tr<pos.trType> <legsAnim>
# <torsoAnim> <eFlags hex> <groundEntityNum> <x y z>`.
